data.one_liner: Location-based augmented reality labels overlaying the camera preview for points of interest.
data.what_it_does: Shows geolocated points of interest as labels over the camera preview, matched to the device's 3D orientation. Automatically stacks overlapping labels and handles smoothed compass and GPS filters.
use_when: Building an AR experience centered around static geolocated points of interest
Displaying directional labels over a live camera preview based on user location and compass heading
avoid_when: Needing general interactive map rendering without camera overlays
Apps that do not require device sensors or geolocation permissions
strengths: Automatic vertical stacking of overlapping labels with stable positioning
Configurable smoothed compass and GPS attitude/location filters
Includes built-in radar and customizable annotation views
weaknesses: Requires proper native permission configuration and specific iOS/Android setup
Depends heavily on device hardware capabilities like compass, gyroscope, and GPS
data.setup_notes: Requires adding camera and location usage descriptions to iOS Info.plist and Podfile preprocessor definitions. Android SDK configuration might be needed depending on the permission_handler version.
